title: Von Neumann extraction tends to fair heads
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$. For each $K$, draw $2K$ independent bits, each equal to $1$ with probability $\rho$, and inspect successive pairs, discarding equal pairs and returning the first bit of the first unequal pair; if there is no unequal pair, return no value. As $K$ tends to infinity, the probability that this procedure returns $1$ converges to $1/2$.
